categories.main_business_segments: Yankuang Energy Group primarily operates in coal mining and sales, coal chemical products production and sales, logistics and transportation, equipment manufacturing, and power generation. The company has diversified into five main industries: mining, high-end chemical new materials, new energy, high-end equipment manufacturing, and smart logistics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as deep coal mine intelligent extraction, digital and intelligent coal mining, and coal indirect liquefaction. It has developed the world's first 8.2-meter super-large mining equipment and operates a million-ton-level coal indirect liquefaction demonstration plant. The company also focuses on clean coal utilization and energy-saving technologies, including distributed photovoltaic power stations and waste heat recovery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yankuang Energy serves customers in power generation, metallurgy, chemical industries, and trade sectors. Its coal products are sold domestically across East China, South China, Central China, North China, Northwest China, and internationally to countries including Japan, South Korea, Australia, and Thailand. Chemical products mainly serve North China, East China, and Northwest China markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China, with key bases in Shandong, Shaanxi, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, and Shanxi provinces. It also has significant overseas operations in Australia, Canada, Germany, Poland, South Africa, Chile, and Russia, with assets and subsidiaries in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yankuang Energy operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the coal and chemical industry supply chain, including coal mining, coal chemical production, and equipment manufacturing. It also engages in downstream logistics, transportation, and power generation, integrating multiple stages of the energy supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in intelligent mining, clean energy, and high-end chemical materials. It invests in R&D platforms, focusing on strategic breakthroughs, industry chain extension, and green low-carbon development. Key R&D initiatives include smart mining technologies, coal gasification, and new energy projects such as wind and photovoltaic power.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of coal, chemical products, and equipment. Additional income streams include logistics services, financing leasing, and power sales. The company also earns investment income and government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yankuang Energy is a leading coal producer and trader in China and Australia, ranking among the top in the industry. It holds a dominant position in domestic thermal coal and is the largest specialized coal producer in Australia. The company competes with major domestic and international coal and chemical enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 139.1 billion and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 14.4 billion. Total assets reached RMB 358.6 billion with a steady growth trajectory despite market challenges. The company maintains a strong capital structure with a debt-to-asset ratio around 63% and continues to invest heavily in capital expenditures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yankuang Energy offers rich resource reserves across multiple regions and diversified coal product types, ensuring supply stability and market adaptability. Its integrated industrial chain from mining to chemical production and logistics provides cost efficiency and risk mitigation. The company’s advanced technology and international presence enable it to deliver high-quality products and services with a focus on sustainability and innovation.
